enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe in and out. Turn body to the left. Pull blanket over shoulder. Adjust pillow under head. Turn body to the right. Extend legs. Flex feet. Turn onto back. Place arm over eyes. Move arm down. Turn onto left side. Curl legs. Relax muscles. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and morning hygiene
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Splash face with water. Pick up soap. Rub hands together. Apply soap to face. Rinse face with water. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit into sink. Put down toothbrush. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making tea with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Close cabinet. Crack eggs into bowl. Beat eggs with fork. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil into pan. Pour eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Pick up plate. Transfer eggs to plate. Fill kettle with water. Plug in kettle. Turn on kettle. Open cabinet. Take out tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Pour hot water from kettle into mug. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink tea. Stand up. Carry dishes to sink. Rinse dishes. Place dishes in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing bag for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Take out shoes. Put on shoes. Open backpack. Place laptop in backpack. Place notebook in backpack. Zip backpack. Pick up phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Put keys in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Stand up. Pull cord. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press button. Wait for elevator. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office door. Open door. Enter office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, coordinating community programs and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email client. Read emails. Reply to emails. Make phone calls. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss program plans. Write reports. Print documents. Talk to colleagues. Organize schedule. Update calendar. Send emails. Review budget. Plan events. Contact community partners. Take break. Stand up. Walk to break room. Get water. Return to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Leave office. Walk to restaurant. Enter restaurant. Order food. Pay for food. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat lunch. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw away trash. Walk back to office. Enter office. Sit at desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the office, running program planning meetings and meeting community partners
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Review notes. Walk to meeting room. Set up projector. Start meeting. Present program plan. Discuss with team. Take questions. Assign tasks. End meeting. Walk back to desk. Check emails. Call community partner. Discuss partnership. Take notes. Send follow-up email. Update project plan. Review budget. Prepare agenda for next meeting. Print materials. File documents. Attend another meeting. Take notes. Return to desk.

Pack bag. Stand up. Walk to elevator. Press button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Stand up. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add sauce. Stir. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Carry dishes to sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying up the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Scrape food off plates. Stack plates. Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Wash plates. Rinse plates. Place plates in drying rack. Wash utensils. Rinse utensils. Place utensils in drying rack. Wipe counter with sponge. Wipe stove with sponge. Throw away trash. Sweep floor. Put away cleaning supplies. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust pillow. Lie back. Watch TV. Change channel again. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer with the desk lamp on to check emails and plan tomorrow's program tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open email client. Check emails. Reply to urgent email. Open calendar. Review tomorrow's schedule. Open task list. Plan program tasks. Write notes. Update task list. Close email client. Open document. Write program plan. Save document. Close computer. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and finishing evening hygiene
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Wait for hot water. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put down toothbrush. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Set alarm on phone. Plug phone into charger. Put phone on nightstand. Take off slippers. Pull back blanket. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn to other side. Stretch legs. Curl up. Move arm. Turn onto back. Snore lightly. Continue sleeping. Turn again. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Sleep.
